prose: James is the inspired intellect behind Family Fungi, a holistic wellness homestead providing mushroom based medicines and do-it-yourself wisdom. We discuss his self-directed education, aligning with your environment, seeing the Logos pattern, enzymes and your endocrine system, and more.
ext: We forage into coffee, chaga, and adaptogens, the difference between mycelium and the mushroom fruit body, maintaining our lymphatic system, our ecology of health practices, and tales of turkey tail.
